title: Daily stats (get_stats)
description:
Returned by garminconnect's get_stats(date). 24/7 wellness metrics — present even on rest days with no logged activity. Consumed by sync_daily_stats.

Verified against: 2026-07-28 (activity day), 2026-07-25 (rest day) — both full responses, confirming these are day-level not activity-level stats. 2026-08-06 (via automatic drift-check on live data, #68): every field below observed null right after day rollover, before Garmin had computed anything for the new day yet — now nullable; see per-field notes. Additional fields beyond what's listed here may exist and are tolerated (additionalProperties: true) — Garmin adding new fields is not a breaking change; a listed field disappearing or changing type is.
